newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa seen in range with softer tone.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa seen in range with softer tone.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE cocoa futures were still seen stuck in a range but with a softer bias in the near term.
July was called to open up five stg at 1,024 stg per tonne, but technical analysts said the upside should be limited.
"The dynamics have changed on the downside," said Susan Rigg, analyst at Chart Analysis. "The rally has run a little bit out of steam."
Rigg expected July to test support at the April 9 low of 980. Though she expected 980 to hold for now, she said it could break in the medium term. If 980 gave way, she forecasted a move to 960.
A U.S. analyst said cycles were showing highs in cocoa on Tuesday but beyond that, cycles pointed to lower prices into Friday.
Further out, he was still overall bullish, noting that "linear cycles are supportive into June."
